  <h2 style="margin-top:0; color:#1a2744;">Tuhinur Rahman Chowdhury</h2>

  **PhD Student in Agricultural & Applied Economics**
  
  Texas Tech University

  I am a PhD student in the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics at Texas Tech University. My research centers on applied econometrics, policy analysis, agricultural labor markets, and rural economic issues, with a focus on using quantitative methods to address real-world challenges. I am especially interested in causal inference, labor economics, and time series analysis.
